alt.id: Ibu melambai kepada tetangga yang berdiri di pintu dan berkata "你好！"; tetangga tersenyum dan melambai balik.
alt.en: Mom waves to a neighbour standing at the door and says "你好！"; the neighbour smiles and waves back.

alt.id: Adik menunjuk Kakak sambil berkata "你好！".
alt.en: Little Sister points at Big Brother and says "你好！".

alt.id: Ibu mengacungkan jempol untuk apel merah yang bagus: "好！"
alt.en: Mom gives a thumbs-up to a nice red apple: "好！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Adik menyapa Kakak dengan santai "你好！". Panel 2: Adik membungkuk sopan kepada Kakek, "您好！".
alt.en: Panel 1: Little Sister greets Big Brother casually, "你好！". Panel 2: she bows politely to Grandpa, "您好！".

alt.id: Bu Guru membuka tangan ke arah Kakak dan temannya: "你们好！"
alt.en: The teacher opens her hand toward Big Brother and his classmate: "你们好！"

alt.id: Ibu menyodorkan piring berisi jeruk kepada teman yang datang: "请！"
alt.en: Mom holds out a plate of oranges to a visiting friend: "请！"

alt.id: Di pasar, Ayah mengangkat tangan dengan sopan untuk bertanya kepada penjual: "请问，……"
alt.en: At the market, Dad politely raises a hand to ask the seller: "请问，……"

alt.id: Ayah memberi Adik balon. Adik senang dan berkata "谢谢！".
alt.en: Dad gives Little Sister a balloon. She is happy and says "谢谢！".

alt.id: Panel 1: Adik berterima kasih kepada Kakak karena bolanya. Panel 2: Kakak melambai santai, "不客气！".
alt.en: Panel 1: Little Sister thanks Big Brother for her ball. Panel 2: he waves it off casually, "不客气！".

alt.id: Kakak menumpahkan teh di meja Ayah, lalu membungkuk: "对不起！"
alt.en: Big Brother spilled tea on Dad’s table and bows: "对不起！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Adik menabrak Nenek, jeruk jatuh, Adik minta maaf. Panel 2: Nenek tersenyum dan melambai, "没关系！".
alt.en: Panel 1: Little Sister bumps into Grandma, oranges fall, she says sorry. Panel 2: Grandma smiles and waves, "没关系！".

alt.id: Adik membawa tas sekolah dan melambai ke Nenek di pintu: "再见！"
alt.en: Little Sister, with her school bag, waves to Grandma at the door: "再见！"

alt.id: Adik menawarkan bakpao kepada Kakak: "吃吗？" Kakak berpikir.
alt.en: Little Sister offers Big Brother a steamed bun: "吃吗？" He thinks about it.

alt.id: Adik menengadah ke gedung yang sangat tinggi sampai menembus awan: "很高！"
alt.en: Little Sister looks up at a building so tall it reaches the clouds: "很高！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Ibu menunjuk dirinya: "我喝茶。" Panel 2: Ibu menunjuk Ayah: "你呢？"
alt.en: Panel 1: Mom points at herself: "我喝茶。" Panel 2: she points at Dad: "你呢？"

alt.id: Kakak memegang bola dan menunjuk ke pintu: "走吧！" Adik mengangguk senang.
alt.en: Big Brother holds a ball and points at the door: "走吧！" Little Sister nods happily.

alt.id: Adik menunjuk dadanya sendiri: "我！"
alt.en: Little Sister points at her own chest: "我！"

alt.id: Adik berkata kepada Ibu sambil menunjuk Ayah di sana: "他是我爸爸。"
alt.en: Little Sister tells Mom while pointing at Dad over there: "他是我爸爸。"

alt.id: Kakak berkata kepada Ayah sambil menunjuk Nenek di seberang ruangan: "她是我奶奶。"
alt.en: Big Brother tells Dad while pointing at Grandma across the room: "她是我奶奶。"

alt.id: Adik menunjuk kucing di sofa dan berkata kepada Ibu: "你看它！"
alt.en: Little Sister points at the cat on the sofa and tells Mom: "你看它！"

alt.id: Adik merentangkan tangan merangkul Ibu dan Kakak: "我们！"
alt.en: Little Sister opens her arms to include Mom and Big Brother: "我们！"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk Ayah dan Kakak yang bermain bola: "他们！"
alt.en: Mom points at Dad and Big Brother playing ball: "他们！"

alt.id: Ayah menunjuk Ibu, Nenek, dan Adik yang membuat pangsit bersama: "她们！"
alt.en: Dad points at Mom, Grandma and Little Sister making dumplings together: "她们！"

alt.id: Di taman, Adik menunjuk dua kucing dan seekor anjing yang bermain, dan berkata kepada Kakak: "你看它们！"
alt.en: In the park, Little Sister points at two cats and a dog playing, and tells Big Brother: "你看它们！"

alt.id: Panel 1: Adik sendirian, "我". Panel 2: Adik bersama teman dan Kakak, "我们".
alt.en: Panel 1: Little Sister alone, "我". Panel 2: with her friend and Big Brother, "我们".

alt.id: Ayah memegang foto bayi dan menunjuk Adik: "这是你。" Adik mengangguk.
alt.en: Dad holds a baby photo and points at Little Sister: "这是你。" She nods.

alt.id: Ibu menyodorkan sayur, Adik menyilangkan tangan dan menggeleng: "不！"
alt.en: Mom offers vegetables; Little Sister crosses her arms and shakes her head: "不！"

alt.id: Kakak mengangkat tangan: "我要！" Adik ikut mengangkat tangan: "我也要！"
alt.en: Big Brother raises his hand: "我要！" Little Sister raises hers too: "我也要！"

alt.id: Ibu memanggil Kakak yang sedang bermain bola dengan tangan di dekat mulut: "哥哥！"
alt.en: Mom calls Big Brother, who is playing ball, with a hand by her mouth: "哥哥！"

alt.id: Hari pertama sekolah: Adik menunjuk label nama di bajunya sambil berkenalan dengan Bu Guru: "我的名字是……"
alt.en: First day of school: Little Sister points at the name tag on her shirt and introduces herself to the teacher: "我的名字是……"

alt.id: Adik memeluk boneka beruangnya, Kakak memegang bolanya; masing-masing berkata "我的！"
alt.en: Little Sister hugs her teddy bear and Big Brother holds his ball; each says "我的！"

alt.id: Satu apel merah di atas meja, dengan angka 1.
alt.en: One red apple on a table, with the digit 1.

alt.id: Dua bakpao putih di atas piring, dengan angka 2.
alt.en: Two white steamed buns on a plate, with the digit 2.

alt.id: Tiga jeruk berjajar di atas meja, dengan angka 3.
alt.en: Three oranges in a row on a table, with the digit 3.

alt.id: Empat cangkir teh di atas meja, dengan angka 4.
alt.en: Four teacups on a table, with the digit 4.

alt.id: Adik membuka lima jari; di sebelahnya ada lima bintang dan angka 5.
alt.en: Little Sister holds up five fingers; next to her are five stars and the digit 5.

alt.id: Enam butir telur berjajar di atas meja, dengan angka 6.
alt.en: Six eggs in a row on a table, with the digit 6.

alt.id: Tujuh pangsit di atas meja (empat di belakang, tiga di depan), dengan angka 7.
alt.en: Seven dumplings on a table (four at the back, three in front), with the digit 7.

alt.id: Delapan balon warna merah melayang berjajar, dengan angka 8.
alt.en: Eight red balloons floating in a row, with the digit 8.

alt.id: Sembilan bola biru dalam tiga baris, dengan angka 9.
alt.en: Nine blue balls in three rows, with the digit 9.

alt.id: Sepuluh apel di atas meja dalam dua baris (5 + 5), dengan angka 10.
alt.en: Ten apples on a table in two rows (5 + 5), with the digit 10.

alt.id: Piring kosong tinggal remah; Adik menunjuknya dengan kecewa. Angka 0.
alt.en: An empty plate with only crumbs; Little Sister points at it, disappointed. The digit 0.

alt.id: Ibu memegang dua gelas teh susu, satu di tiap tangan, dengan angka 2.
alt.en: Mom holds two cups of milk tea, one in each hand, with the digit 2.

alt.id: Ibu bertanya "几个？" sambil memegang permen; Adik menebak dengan tiga jari.
alt.en: Mom asks "几个？" holding sweets; Little Sister guesses with three fingers.

alt.id: Di pasar, Ayah menunjuk tumpukan jeruk dan bertanya kepada penjual: "多少钱？"
alt.en: At the market, Dad points at a pile of oranges and asks the seller: "多少钱？"

alt.id: Adik memegang apel di dekatnya dan menunjuknya: "这个！" Apel lain ada jauh di meja.
alt.en: Little Sister holds an apple close and points at it: "这个！" Another apple is far away on a table.

alt.id: Adik menunjuk apel yang jauh di meja seberang ruangan: "那个！"
alt.en: Little Sister points at an apple far away on a table across the room: "那个！"

alt.id: Adik menyodorkan boneka beruang di tangannya ke depan: "这个！" Mainan lain masih di rak.
alt.en: Little Sister holds out the teddy bear in her hand: "这个！" The other toys stay on the shelf.

alt.id: Kakak menunjuk sepeda merah yang jauh di seberang jalan, bukan sepeda biru di dekatnya: "那个！"
alt.en: Big Brother points at the red bicycle far across the street, not the blue one beside him: "那个！"

alt.id: Adik memeluk beberapa boneka di dadanya: "这些！" Boneka lain ada jauh di rak.
alt.en: Little Sister hugs several stuffed toys to her chest: "这些！" Other toys sit far away on a shelf.

alt.id: Adik menunjuk sekelompok boneka di rak yang jauh: "那些！"
alt.en: Little Sister points at a group of stuffed toys on a shelf far away: "那些！"

alt.id: Ibu duduk di sofa dan menepuk tempat kosong di sebelahnya, memanggil Adik: "坐这儿！"
alt.en: Mom sits on the sofa and pats the empty spot beside her, calling Little Sister: "坐这儿！"

alt.id: Kakak menunjuk kedai teh susu di seberang jalan sambil bicara dengan temannya: "那儿！"
alt.en: Big Brother points at the milk tea shop across the street while talking to his classmate: "那儿！"

alt.id: Ayah memegang peta taman dan menunjuk tanah tepat di dekat kakinya, ada tanda lokasi: "这里！"
alt.en: Dad holds a park map and points at the ground right by his feet, where a location pin is: "这里！"

alt.id: Kakek menunjuk pagoda jauh di atas bukit; Adik ikut melihat: "在那里！"
alt.en: Grandpa points far off to a pagoda on a hill; Little Sister looks: "在那里！"

alt.id: Di restoran, pelayan mempersilakan Ibu ke meja di dekatnya dengan telapak terbuka: "这边请！"
alt.en: In a restaurant, the waiter shows Mom to the table right next to him with an open palm: "这边请！"

alt.id: Pelayan menunjuk meja kosong jauh di dekat jendela: "那边！"
alt.en: The waiter points to an empty table far away by the window: "那边！"

alt.id: Adik bangga memamerkan boneka beruangnya: "我有！" Kakak di sebelahnya menunjukkan dua tangan kosong.
alt.en: Little Sister proudly shows her teddy bear: "我有！" Big Brother next to her shows two empty hands.

alt.id: Kakak membalik dompetnya, tetapi yang keluar hanya debu: "我没有钱。"
alt.en: Big Brother turns his wallet upside down, but only dust falls out: "我没有钱。"

alt.id: Adik bersembunyi di dalam lemari, hanya kepalanya yang terlihat; panah menunjuk tempatnya: "我在这儿！"
alt.en: Little Sister hides in the wardrobe with only her head peeking out; an arrow points to her: "我在这儿！"

alt.id: Adik mengguncang kotak hadiah tertutup di dekat telinganya: "什么？"
alt.en: Little Sister shakes a closed gift box next to her ear: "什么？"

alt.id: Bel pintu berbunyi. Di jendela kecil pintu ada bayangan orang; Adik bertanya: "谁？"
alt.en: The doorbell rings. A shadow shows in the door’s small window; Little Sister asks: "谁？"

alt.id: Di penjual balon, Adik ragu memilih di antara tiga balon berbeda warna: "哪个？"
alt.en: At a balloon stand, Little Sister can’t decide between three balloons of different colours: "哪个？"

alt.id: Adik berdiri di depan tiga boneka beruang di rak toko dan berpikir: "哪个？"
alt.en: Little Sister stands in front of three teddy bears on a shop shelf, wondering: "哪个？"

alt.id: Penjual menyodorkan keranjang buah; Ibu berpikir mau pilih yang mana saja: "哪些？"
alt.en: The seller holds out a basket of fruit; Mom wonders which ones to pick: "哪些？"

alt.id: Di stasiun kereta bawah tanah, Adik bingung melihat peta jalur: "我在哪儿？"
alt.en: In a metro station, Little Sister looks at the route map, confused: "我在哪儿？"

alt.id: Di bandara, Ibu menarik koper dan bingung mencari gerbangnya: "在哪里？"
alt.en: At the airport, Mom pulls her suitcase, looking around for her gate: "在哪里？"

alt.id: Kakek memegang ponsel baru dan bingung cara memakainya: "怎么用？"
alt.en: Grandpa holds a new phone, puzzled how to use it: "怎么用？"

alt.id: Ibu menunjukkan baju barunya kepada Ayah: "怎么样？" Ayah mengacungkan jempol.
alt.en: Mom shows Dad her new top: "怎么样？" Dad gives a thumbs-up.

alt.id: Di kelas, Adik mengangkat tangan dan bertanya kepada Guru (balon tanda tanya).
alt.en: In class, Little Sister raises her hand and asks the teacher a question (a question-mark balloon).

alt.id: Adik mengangkat tangan dengan tanda tanya besar di dekatnya: "我有问题！" Guru tersenyum.
alt.en: Little Sister raises her hand, a big question mark beside her: "我有问题！" The teacher smiles.

alt.id: Di papan tulis tertulis 2 + 2 = 4. Bu Guru tersenyum dan memberi centang: "对！"
alt.en: The blackboard shows 2 + 2 = 4. The teacher smiles and adds a big tick: "对！"

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk tiga apel di meja: "三个！"
alt.en: Mom points at three apples on the table: "三个！"

alt.id: Papan berisi sepuluh baris bintang, sepuluh bintang tiap baris, dengan angka 100.
alt.en: A board with ten rows of ten stars each, with the digit 100.

alt.id: Sepuluh papan, tiap papan berisi seratus titik, dengan angka 1000 di atasnya.
alt.en: Ten boards of one hundred dots each, with the number 1000 above them.

alt.id: Podium lomba lari: Kakak di nomor 1, temannya nomor 2, Ayah yang kelelahan nomor 3.
alt.en: A race podium: Big Brother is number 1, his classmate number 2, and a tired Dad number 3.

alt.id: Kalender dinding dengan tanggal 15 dilingkari; Adik menunjuknya: "十五号！"
alt.en: A wall calendar with the 15th circled; Little Sister points at it: "十五号！"

alt.id: Adik bersorak di depan kue ulang tahun dengan lilin angka 6: "我六岁！"
alt.en: Little Sister cheers in front of a birthday cake with a number-6 candle: "我六岁！"

alt.id: Dua mangkuk: satu penuh pangsit, satu hanya berisi dua. Kakak menunjuk yang penuh: "多！"
alt.en: Two bowls: one piled with dumplings, one with only two. Big Brother points at the full one: "多！"

alt.id: Dua mangkuk: satu penuh pangsit, satu hanya berisi dua. Adik cemberut menunjuk yang hampir kosong: "少！"
alt.en: Two bowls: one piled with dumplings, one with only two. Little Sister pouts and points at the nearly empty one: "少！"

alt.id: Ibu membelah semangka jadi dua bagian sama besar dan mengangkat setengahnya: "半个"
alt.en: Mom cuts a watermelon into two equal halves and lifts one: "半个"

alt.id: Kakak membagi bakpao jadi dua dan memberi setengahnya kepada Adik: "一半给你！"
alt.en: Big Brother breaks a steamed bun in two and gives half to Little Sister: "一半给你！"

alt.id: Ayah menuang teh sedikit saja ke cangkir Adik; Adik memberi isyarat "sedikit": "一点儿！"
alt.en: Dad pours just a little tea into Little Sister’s cup; she makes a "little" sign: "一点儿！"

alt.id: Adik menyentuh cangkir teh yang mengepul dan memberi isyarat "sedikit" dengan jarinya: "有点儿热！"
alt.en: Little Sister touches a steaming cup of tea and shows "a little" with her fingers: "有点儿热！"

alt.id: Ada banyak pangsit di piring; Kakak mengambil beberapa ke mangkuknya: "我吃一些。"
alt.en: There are lots of dumplings on a plate; Big Brother takes a few into his bowl: "我吃一些。"

alt.id: Di meja ada setumpuk besar jeruk; Ibu mengambil beberapa (empat) ke dalam mangkuknya.
alt.en: There is a big pile of oranges on the table; Mom takes a few (four) into her bowl.

alt.id: Guru bertanya ke kelas. Ada yang bisa menjawab dan mengangkat tangan, ada yang menggaruk kepala: "有的会".
alt.en: The teacher asks the class. Some students know and raise their hands, one scratches his head: "有的会".

alt.id: Satu tandan pisang di meja: beberapa sudah kuning, beberapa masih hijau. Adik menunjuknya.
alt.en: A bunch of bananas on the table: some are already yellow, some are still green. Little Sister points at it.

alt.id: Orang berjalan dilihat dari samping: kedua kakinya seperti huruf V terbalik, lalu menjadi aksara 人.
alt.en: A person walking, seen from the side: the legs make an upside-down V, which became the character 人.

alt.id: Ibu dan temannya tertawa bersama sambil minum bubble tea di kedai.
alt.en: Mom and her friend laugh together over bubble tea at a tea shop.

alt.id: Kakak dan teman kuliahnya duduk bersebelahan di kelas, berbagi satu buku.
alt.en: Big Brother and his classmate sit side by side in class, sharing one book.

alt.id: Ibu melambai ke seluruh keluarga di meja makan: "大家，吃饭了！"
alt.en: Mom waves to the whole family at the dining table: "大家，吃饭了！"

alt.id: Pelayan membungkuk sopan menyambut Ayah di restoran: "先生，您好！"
alt.en: The waiter bows politely to welcome Dad at the restaurant: "先生，您好！"

alt.id: Pelayan membungkuk sopan menyambut Ibu yang membawa tas tangan: "女士，您好！"
alt.en: The waiter bows politely to greet Mom, who carries a handbag: "女士，您好！"

alt.id: Ayah dan Kakak (laki-laki) di kiri, di bawah tanda laki-laki ♂; Ibu dan Adik di kanan.
alt.en: Dad and Big Brother (male) on the left, under the male sign ♂; Mom and Little Sister on the right.

alt.id: Ibu dan Adik (perempuan) di kanan, di bawah tanda perempuan ♀; Ayah dan Kakak di kiri.
alt.en: Mom and Little Sister (female) on the right, under the female sign ♀; Dad and Big Brother on the left.

alt.id: Di taman, Adik melompat riang di antara Ayah dan Ibu; panah menunjuk sang anak.
alt.en: In the park, Little Sister hops happily between Mom and Dad; an arrow points at the child.

alt.id: Guru membungkuk ramah dan menepuk kepala Adik: "小朋友，你好！"
alt.en: The teacher bends down kindly and pats Little Sister on the head: "小朋友，你好！"

alt.id: Seorang wanita muda menunjuk pemuda di sampingnya: "他是我男朋友。" Ada hati kecil di antara mereka.
alt.en: A young woman points at the young man beside her: "他是我男朋友。" Little hearts float between them.

alt.id: Seorang pemuda menunjuk wanita muda di sampingnya: "她是我女朋友。" Ada hati kecil di antara mereka.
alt.en: A young man points at the young woman beside him: "她是我女朋友。" Little hearts float between them.

alt.id: Nenek membawa sepiring pangsit, dan semua yang lain mengangkat tangan: "我们都要！"
alt.en: Grandma brings a plate of dumplings, and everyone else raises a hand: "我们都要！"

alt.id: Di nampan ada bakpao dan segelas susu, dengan tanda tambah di antaranya; Adik berkata "包子和牛奶！"
alt.en: A tray holds a steamed bun and a glass of milk with a plus sign between them; Little Sister says "包子和牛奶！"

alt.id: Atas: atap di atas babi menjadi aksara 家 (rumah). Bawah: seluruh keluarga Xiǎo di ruang keluarga mereka.
alt.en: Top: a roof over a pig became the character 家 (home). Below: the whole Xiǎo family in their living room.

alt.id: Keenam anggota keluarga Xiǎo berdiri berjajar di ruang keluarga dan tersenyum.
alt.en: All six members of the Xiǎo family stand in a row in their living room, smiling.

alt.id: Di ruang keluarga, Adik berlari ke Ayah yang membuka tangan: "爸爸！"
alt.en: In the living room, Little Sister runs to Dad, who opens his arms: "爸爸！"

alt.id: Ibu mengelus kepala Adik, Ayah duduk di sofa: "妈妈！"
alt.en: Mom pats Little Sister's head while Dad sits on the sofa: "妈妈！"

alt.id: Kakak memberi bola kepada Adik yang lebih kecil: "哥哥！" Ayah dan Ibu duduk di sofa.
alt.en: Big Brother hands a ball to his little sister: "哥哥！" Dad and Mom sit on the sofa.

alt.id: Ibu menunjuk foto lama di dinding: ia waktu kecil bersama kakak perempuannya yang lebih tinggi (ditandai panah): "这是我姐姐。"
alt.en: Mom points at an old photo on the wall: herself as a little girl with her taller older sister (marked by an arrow): "这是我姐姐。"

alt.id: Ayah menunjuk foto lama di dinding: ia waktu remaja bersama adik laki-lakinya yang kecil (ditandai panah): "这是我弟弟。"
alt.en: Dad points at an old photo on the wall: himself as a boy with his little brother (marked by an arrow): "这是我弟弟。"

alt.id: Kakak menunjuk adik perempuannya yang kecil (ditandai panah): "这是我妹妹。" Kakek dan Nenek duduk di sofa.
alt.en: Big Brother points at his little sister (marked by an arrow): "这是我妹妹。" Grandpa and Grandma sit on the sofa.

alt.id: Ayah merangkul Kakak yang memegang piala dengan bangga: "这是我儿子！"
alt.en: Dad proudly puts his hand on Big Brother, who holds a trophy: "这是我儿子！"

alt.id: Ibu menyisir rambut Adik (ditandai panah): "这是我女儿。" Keluarga lain duduk di sofa.
alt.en: Mom combs Little Sister's hair (marked by an arrow): "这是我女儿。" The rest of the family sits on the sofa.

alt.id: Malam hari, Adik menunjuk satu jendela yang menyala di gedung apartemen; di dalamnya keluarganya sedang makan: "我住这儿！"
alt.en: At night, Little Sister points at one lit window of an apartment block where her family is eating: "我住这儿！"

alt.id: Kamar Adik: meja belajar, tempat tidur kecil, dan boneka; Adik duduk di lantai bermain.
alt.en: Little Sister's room: a desk, a small bed and soft toys; she sits on the floor playing.

alt.id: Meja makan kayu dengan empat kursi di sekelilingnya; panah menunjuk mejanya.
alt.en: A wooden dining table with four chairs around it; an arrow points at the table.

alt.id: Kakek memegang koran dan menunjuk kursi kayu yang kosong (ditandai panah).
alt.en: Grandpa holds his newspaper and points at an empty wooden chair (marked by an arrow).

alt.id: Anjing kecil berbulu kuning berlari mengibaskan ekor; Adik melempar bola untuknya.
alt.en: A small yellow dog runs wagging its tail; Little Sister throws a ball for it.

alt.id: Kucing belang oranye tidur melingkar di sofa; Adik mengelus kepalanya.
alt.en: An orange tabby cat sleeps curled up on the sofa; Little Sister strokes its head.

alt.id: Tiga burung kecil bertengger di satu dahan, dengan angka 3.
alt.en: Three small birds perch on one branch, with the number 3.

alt.id: Ibu melambai memanggil Adik sebentar: "来一下！"
alt.en: Mom waves Little Sister over for a moment: "来一下！"
